summary: This 5-page operational synthesis applies the author's coherence-maintenance and resource-boundary framework ([2-7]) to audit the 71-THz lipid CH2 "mito-polariton" hypothesis from an unrefereed bioRxiv preprint ([12]). All core algebraic identities, numerical bounds, Bogoliubov weights, Table 1 Lean statements, Table 2 certificates (C01-C16), and Figures 1-3 are internally consistent and verified against the PDF. Five main results hold: (i) a +3.61 THz Hopfield A^2 blue-shift of the upper polariton (106.61 vs. 103 THz) at η ≈ 0.2046; (ii) a 5.15×10^5× ATP-budget deficit against bulk-water dephasing separating zero-cost passive polaritons (Regime I) from active coherence requiring κ↓ ≲ 2×10^6 s^-1 (Regime II); (iii) an irreducible ω = 0 Davies floor despite ≥5× detuning suppression and cristae collar rip-u; (iv) Coulomb-gauge Bogoliubov dark-mode leakage (w_mat^Coul ≈ 0.6002 > 1/2) with no 1/N protection alongside an S-lamella multi-port shielding bound; and (v) a four-test falsification matrix. Minor issues (off-resonance D vs 4g^2 convention, ~1% |u_b|^2 vs w_mat^Coul jump-rate subtlety, D2O 74.9-THz overlap with 71 THz, T2* vs T2 in Table 3, and arithmetic-only scope of Lean 4 proofs) do not invalidate any main result.
weaknesses: Self-containedness: most foundational thermodynamic and network theorems (Theorem 4.1, Theorem 9.1, rip-u, Davies ω = 0 floor, multi-port filter bound) are imported from the author's prior 2025-2026 AIRR.SCIENCE papers [2-7] rather than derived within this manuscript.

Scope of formal verification: Table 1 shows that the 18 Lean 4.35.0 theorems formalize integer/rational algebraic identities and arithmetic shadows (e.g., Thm 11 fawzi_renner_fidelity_gap_algebraic is (b-a)a ≤ (b-a)b) rather than Hilbert-space open-quantum-system or quantum-information proofs.

Empirical target [12] is an unrefereed preprint awaiting independent replication, and the CD2 isotope simulation C03 holds g = 15 THz fixed rather than scaling the transition dipole / plasma frequency under mass doubling.

Minor discrepancy in Figure 1a vs 1b framing: Fig. 1a plots RWA branches ω0 ± g at η_Hop = 0.2046 (~104.8 THz), whereas Fig. 1b and text compare against the naive RWA upper branch 103 THz inferred from ν- = 71 THz (g_RWA = 16 THz, η_RWA ≈ 0.1839); explicit labeling would avoid reader confusion.
